name: DesignQA v2 — Functional Performance RAG
protocol: DesignQA v2 Functional Performance 16-question subset, simple LlamaIndex RAG, temperature 0.1; AllRules and GuaranteedRAG excluded.

explanation.en: Exact yes/no accuracy over the fixed 16-question subset under the simple-RAG setup.
explanation.zh: 在 simple-RAG 设置下计算固定 16 题 subset 的 yes/no 准确率。

summary.en: DesignQA evaluates applying Formula SAE requirements to engineering-design evidence.
summary.zh: DesignQA 评估把 Formula SAE 规范应用到工程设计证据的能力。

task_format.en: Use retrieved rulebook context and visual evidence to make 16 binary functional-compliance decisions.
task_format.zh: 结合检索到的规则文本和视觉证据，完成 16 道二元功能合规判断。
